name: SDRED
recent: SDRED 于 2026 年 9 月 30 日召开第 65 届常年股东大会，所有决议均获通过，包括派发每股 3 仙股息。公司于 11 月 24 日发布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度的财报。近期没有重要新闻。
notable: 第 65 届常年股东大会于 2026 年 9 月 30 日举行，所有决议均获股东通过。
股东批准派发截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日止年度每股 3 仙的股息。

recent_en: SDRED held its 65th AGM on 30 Sep 2026, where all resolutions were passed, including a dividend of 3 sen per share. The company released its quarterly report for the period ended 30 Sep 2026 on 24 Nov. There is no significant recent news.
notable_en: The 65th AGM was held on 30 Sep 2026 and all resolutions were passed by shareholders.
